title: Remove command refresh target flat alias
summary: Removed the command-history commandHistoryRefreshTarget flat window alias and migrated Launch command review refresh-handoff lookup to the mediaPipelineCommandHistory namespace helper.
reason: Continue opportunistic namespace-first WebView cleanup without changing backend routes, command ownership, media policy, or mutation behavior.
behavior_before: commandHistory.js exposed commandHistoryRefreshTarget through both window.mediaPipelineCommandHistory and a transitional flat window.commandHistoryRefreshTarget alias consumed by launchHistoryView.js.
behavior_after: launchHistoryView.js resolves commandHistoryRefreshTarget from window.mediaPipelineCommandHistory; commandHistory.js keeps the namespace export and no longer publishes window.commandHistoryRefreshTarget. Flat WebView exports are now 637 across 49 files.
tests_added: Updated Local API static assertions to require namespace access, reject the removed flat alias, and verify Launch command review uses the namespace helper.
manual_validation: Post-change: WebViewInventoryDocsTests global export summary and manifest checks OK.
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet and commit to restore the commandHistoryRefreshTarget flat alias, the prior Launch command review call path, and the previous WebView export inventory/contract counts.
notes:
Scope is WebView flat-export cleanup only. No backend command routes, command journal semantics, strict confirmations, filesystem mutation, source media, pending publish, repair/reconcile, encoder, or media-policy behavior changed.
